title: Exceptional integral scalar mates: one reduction record
statement: For fixed finite-field datum, compactification, transported mate record, field stage E and level n under the hypotheses of lem-sf-exceptional-integral-scalar-mates, there exists one ReductionMates record at E and n.

source.place: Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.26, finite-level reduction comparison for one coefficient stage and level.

proof.text: Construct the two canonical finite evaluation isomorphisms by full-inclusion lifting; their ambient normalizations are integralReductionEvaluation_normalized.

Use the normalized left reduction square. Derive the system reduction counit by equivalence conjugation from adjunction_eq and reductionF_eq/reductionG_eq, and then evaluate it using evaluation_counit. The finite counit equation for d and injectivity of the target adjunction Hom bijection force the right reduction square. Assemble these four fields into ReductionMates.

proof_origin.place: Finite reduction step: canonical evaluation, left square, then uniqueness of the counit-normalized right mate.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalIntegralScalarMates_data_reduction_pointwise
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (transport : Transported l Ω D hl c operation left)
    (d : Mates l Ω c operation left) (E : FieldStage.{u} l) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (ReductionMates l Ω D hl c operation left transport d E n)
